topic: How GTA 6's wanted system works: 6 stars, hollow vs solid vs red stars, witnesses, what police know

topic_score.why: Almost every player meets the police in their first hour, but nobody needs this before launch day.

title: GTA 6 wanted stars: hollow, solid or RED?
description: GTA 6 has six wanted stars, one more than GTA 5's five. Rockstar says police only hear about a crime from a witness or an alarm. What the hollow, solid white and red stars mean comes from press previews, so it is reported, not confirmed by Rockstar.

lines.say: In GTA 5, five stars. In GTA 6, six.
But the stars aren't the clever part. Let me explain.
Rockstar says police only hear about a crime from a witness or an alarm.

beats.text: A crime needs a witness, or an alarm.

lines.say: A hollow star reportedly means a crime was reported but police have no description of you.
A solid white star reportedly means police can see you right now.
A red star reportedly means you escaped but police are still searching.
Police can reportedly know your outfit and your getaway car.
So before you run, think. Who saw you? And what did they see?
In GTA 6, six stars is the easy part.
